title: Astro Upfront 2027 — TV, Audio, Talent & On-Ground Packages
summary: Upfront27: Best of TV RM25k–55k, news packages RM15k–38k, audio RM5k–47.5k, talent/creator RM5k–75k, festive RM88k–250k.
description: Astro Upfront27 sales kit (66 pages) with early-bird bonuses: 100% for sign-up by 30 Oct 2026, 50% by 16 Nov 2026, 20% by 30 Nov 2026. TV: Awani Pagi and Niaga Awani spotlight interviews RM20,000; Buletin Awani special report RM15,000; AEC Prime Talk Market Spotlite RM25,000 plus RM3,000 production; Prime Edition News RM38,000; SME Biz@Sethigal RM5,300–8,300; Best of Malay/Chinese/Indian TV RM25,000–55,000; Best of CNY 2027 RM88,000; CNY Greetings RM120,000; Best of Raya 2027 RM98,000; Raya celebrity greetings RM250,000. Audio: Audio Impact 360 RM5,000–20,000 per brand; nationwide ERA/MYFM/HITZ RM40,000–47,500; regional RM2,800–43,000; CNY/Raya audio sponsorships RM160,000–188,000. Talent: RFE talent posts RM5,000–20,000, music talent RM10,000–30,000, music and MV production RM35,000–75,000; KULT creators RM10,000–50,000. On-ground booth RM10,000–15,000 and AIdvert production RM6,000. Prices exclude 8% SST; production and talent are charged separately.
validity: Upfront27; early-bird deadlines Oct–Nov 2026, utilise by 31 Dec 2027
